basics.name: Mina Girgis
basics.label: Computer Engineering Student
basics.summary: I am a Computer Engineering student at the University of Hawaii. I am interested in hardware, embedded systems, AI security, cybersecurity, electrical systems, and software engineering. I enjoy learning how hardware and software work together to solve engineering problems.

Gained exposure to PLC systems and industrial control equipment
Worked with GE Fanuc 90-30 and ABB AC500 systems
Learned about HMI systems used to monitor and control equipment
Assisted with hardware, communication, and system troubleshooting
Gained experience working with engineering documentation and electrical systems

volunteer.summary: Worked on projects exploring security weaknesses in artificial intelligence systems.
highlights: Tested large language models using jailbreaking techniques
Explored prompt-based attacks and AI system behavior
Studied RAG poisoning and how untrusted information can affect AI responses
Analyzed security risks involving large language models and RAG systems
